name: Historical Licenses
description:
This dataset contains historical business license records, primarily for New York City, with each row representing a single license held by a business or individual. It includes the license number, type (Business or Individual), creation and expiration dates, current status (such as CURRENT, FAILED TO RENEW, OUT OF BUSINESS, or SURRENDERED), and the date the status was recorded. Business details include a business code and description (for example, pawnbroker, newsstand, or second hand dealer), business name, and contact phone number where available. Location information covers street address, city, state, ZIP code, borough, community board, council district, and geographic identifiers such as latitude, longitude, BIN, BBL, and NTA codes, though these geographic fields are missing for roughly 40% of rows.

It belongs to the business and government administration domain, specifically municipal licensing and regulatory records. Possible uses include analyzing business license trends over time, mapping business activity by neighborhood or borough, studying license status and expiration patterns, supporting economic development or urban planning research, and geocoding or joining records to other NYC geographic datasets.
